readout.output_pooling: 161 fixed seed-0 selected tokens, then mean across windows per clip
readout.probe: training-only StandardScaler and class-balanced logistic regression

rf.historical_difference: Earlier left ankle range field duplicated right ankle range; primary run uses corrected left ankle range.

anonymization: Recording and clip identifiers are replaced by S001... and C001...; original identifiers and mapping are not included. These identifiers do not establish unique participants.
diagnostics: Values transcribed at six-decimal precision from saved notebook03 cell18. Loss averages masked-target token cross-entropy within windows then across the batch. Rank and embedding standard deviation use all-token teacher-pooled window vectors after the EMA update. Drift averages tensor-wise 1-cosine of student and teacher parameters after the optimizer step and before EMA, with denominator clamped at 1e-9. The CSV gives each aggregation rule; these are training diagnostics, not a full learning-curve history.
